posts.author: drawpunzel
posts.body:
Hi all!
after lurking on this forum for a good two months I guess it's finally time to introduce myself!
My name is Conny aka Drawpunzel - next to my average day job, I'm a writer, artist, and I guess now also gamedev
I discovered RPG Maker (MZ) just a couple of weeks back and instantly fell down this amazing rabbit hole of possibilities.
As a first project I'm working on a cozy game! Which has of course gotten huge in scope in no time
I'm currently rotating between setting up the basic game mechanics, outlining the story and finding a fitting visual style! It'll probably take quite some time until I can actually share stuff, until then I will just continue lurking and come out of hiding for the occasional plugin/coding question
Thank you for being such a cool and supportive community, all your posts have already helped me tremedously with learning and troubleshooting!
See you around!
Conny

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule

Welcome to the forum and to your possible new hobby obsession!
One of my biggest regrets is that I didn't stumble upon RPG Maker years ago. I also just discovered MZ almost 4 years ago and I fell hard into the rabbit hole.
This is a pretty great community with lots of helpful people and terrific resources.
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
